name: Mechanical Orchard (Imogen)
location_or_channel: Enterprise sales; free proof of concept (https://mechanical-orchard.com/)
price_of_comparable_item: not public (vendor says outcome-based, "Priced on proof")
what_it_sells: AI rewrite of mainframe systems, verified against captured data flows at component interfaces; mainframe stacks only (CICS, IMS, PL/1, DB2, VSAM...)

name: AWS Transform for mainframe
price_of_comparable_item: Mainframe modernization agent: Free (https://aws.amazon.com/transform/pricing/); runtime $0.31 per CPU core per hour (https://aws.amazon.com/mainframe-modernization/pricing)
what_it_sells: AI mainframe migration plus test plan generation and test data collection "for functional equivalence testing"; IBM z/OS batch only (Dec 2025)

name: Tusk (Tusk Drift)
price_of_comparable_item: $50/mo per active dev, Team plan; Free tier (https://usetusk.ai/pricing)
what_it_sells: Records production API traffic via Node/Python SDK and replays it against PRs with mocked dependencies; AI unit tests and code review
positioning_line: AI verification layer for coding agents

name: Keploy
price_of_comparable_item: $19/user/mo + usage, Pro; open source and Playground free (https://keploy.io/pricing)
what_it_sells: eBPF capture of API traffic and dependency calls, turned into tests and mocks replayed in CI
positioning_line: AI writes code. Keploy catches what breaks

name: Speedscale
price_of_comparable_item: not public; Free proxymock tier, Pro price not listed (https://speedscale.com/pricing/)
what_it_sells: Traffic capture and replay of HTTP, gRPC, database and queue calls against a changed service
positioning_line: Record your traffic. Replay it against your change.

name: Meticulous
what_it_sells: Records sessions in JS frontends (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js...), replays them on each PR with recorded backend responses, visual diffs

name: GoReplay
what_it_sells: Captures live HTTP traffic and replays it into a test environment (shadowing)
positioning_line: open-source tool for capturing and replaying live HTTP traffic into a test environment (excerpt of repo blurb)

name: Qodo
price_of_comparable_item: $30, Pro Team (up to 30 users) + credits at $0.012 (https://www.qodo.ai/pricing/)
what_it_sells: AI code review and test generation for PRs
positioning_line: Qodo 3.0: Quality Control for the Agentic Software Factory

name: Chromatic
what_it_sells: Visual regression testing of UI components and pages (snapshot diffs)
positioning_line: Ship flawless UIs with less work

name: Playwright (codegen recorder)
what_it_sells: Browser automation framework; its recorder writes test code from clicks
positioning_line: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.

name: Hand-written characterization tests (e.g. ApprovalTests)
what_it_sells: Golden master / approval testing library; developer writes and maintains the tests

name: Parallel run of old and new systems
price_of_comparable_item: not public (two systems run at once + comparison work)
what_it_sells: Run legacy and new side by side on the same inputs, compare outputs
positioning_line: "run legacy and modernized systems in parallel before shifting traffic" (Fullstack, practice description)

name: Manual QA
what_it_sells: Humans click through and check results
positioning_line: "humans must validate batch windows, transaction spikes, decimal precision, and character-encoding conversion" (Fullstack)

name: Doing nothing (trust the rewrite)
what_it_sells: Ship the change and rely on tests that exist plus vendor claims
positioning_line: Warned against: "take functional equivalence on faith" (SoftwareReviews, 2026-09-24)
